source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON 	SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED DECLARE @adhoc_dt DateTime SET @adhoc_dt = ?  IF @adhoc_dt = \'12/30/1899\' 	/* PULL DETAIL RECORDS */ 	( 	SELECT 		\'D\'																												+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(MEDICAID_ID,\' \') ,\'\')+SPACE(12),1,12)													+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(PREGNANCY_INDICATOR, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'U\') +SPACE(1),1,1)							+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(PREGNANCY_START_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)					+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(PREGNANCY_END_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)						+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(PREGNANCY_EST_DUE_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)					+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(PREG_DELIV_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)						+\' \'																											+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(MED_FRAIL_INDICATOR, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'U\') +SPACE(1),1,1)							+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(MED_FRAIL_CONFIRM_CODE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'U\') +SPACE(1),1,1)						+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(MED_FRAIL_LST_CNFRM_ASMNT_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)			+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(MED_FRAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'N\')+SPACE(1),1,1)					+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(COST_SHARE_MET_INDICATOR, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'U\')+SPACE(1),1,1)						+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(COST_SHARE_MET_START_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)				+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(COST_SHARE_MET_END_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)				+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(TOBACCO_INDICATOR, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'U\')+SPACE(1),1,1)								+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(TOBACCO_USE_EFF_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)					+SPACE(66) AS \'PrintLine\' 	FROM ODW.DW.AGP_AGP_IN_SUPPL_FILE (NOLOCK) 	/* SNOW-16956: Removed the VARCHAR convert which was causing erraneous data to be reported */ 	WHERE CONVERT(date,RECORD_CREATE_DTTM) >= 	(	 		CASE 				when   datename(dw,GETDATE()) = \'Monday\' then  DATEADD(DD,-3,CONVERT(DATE,getdate())) 				else   DATEADD(DD,-1,CONVERT(date,getdate())) 		END  	) 	 	/* TRAILER DETAIL RECORD */ 	UNION ALL 	SELECT  		SUBSTRING(  				\'T\'+  				RIGHT(\'00000000\'+ 				cast(  						( 						SELECT COUNT(1)+1 						FROM	ODW.DW.AGP_AGP_IN_SUPPL_FILE (NOLOCK) 						WHERE	CONVERT(date,RECORD_CREATE_DTTM) >=    							(	 								CASE  									WHEN datename(dw,GETDATE()) = \'Monday\' then  DATEADD(DD,-3,CONVERT(DATE,getdate())) 									ELSE DATEADD(DD,-1,CONVERT(date,getdate())) 								END 							) 						) AS VARCHAR(MAX) 					),8) 					+SPACE(150),1,150 				)		 ) ELSE ( 	SELECT 		\'D\'																												+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(MEDICAID_ID,\' \') ,\'\')+SPACE(12),1,12)													+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(PREGNANCY_INDICATOR, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'U\') +SPACE(1),1,1)							+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(PREGNANCY_START_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)					+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(PREGNANCY_END_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)						+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(PREGNANCY_EST_DUE_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)					+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(PREG_DELIV_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)						+\' \'																											+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(MED_FRAIL_INDICATOR, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'U\') +SPACE(1),1,1)							+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(MED_FRAIL_CONFIRM_CODE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'U\') +SPACE(1),1,1)						+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(MED_FRAIL_LST_CNFRM_ASMNT_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)			+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(MED_FRAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'N\')+SPACE(1),1,1)					+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(COST_SHARE_MET_INDICATOR, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'U\')+SPACE(1),1,1)						+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(COST_SHARE_MET_START_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)				+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(COST_SHARE_MET_END_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)				+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(TOBACCO_INDICATOR, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'U\')+SPACE(1),1,1)								+SUBSTRING(ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(TOBACCO_USE_EFF_DATE, \' \',\'\'),\'\'),\'00000000\') +SPACE(8),1,8)					+SPACE(66) AS \'PrintLine\' 	FROM ODW.DW.AGP_AGP_IN_SUPPL_FILE (NOLOCK) 	/* SNOW-16956: Removed the VARCHAR convert which was causing erraneous data to be reported */ 	WHERE	CONVERT(date,RECORD_CREATE_DTTM) >= CONVERT(date,@adhoc_dt) 	 	/* TRAILER DETAIL RECORD */ 	UNION ALL 	SELECT  		SUBSTRING(  				\'T\'+  				RIGHT(\'00000000\'+ 				cast(  						( 						SELECT COUNT(1)+1 						FROM	ODW.DW.AGP_AGP_IN_SUPPL_FILE (NOLOCK) 						WHERE	CONVERT(date,RECORD_CREATE_DTTM) >= CONVERT(date,@adhoc_dt) 						) AS VARCHAR(MAX) 					),8) 					+SPACE(150),1,150 				)	 )		                                                                                                                                           END',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCINSUPPL
OLESRCINSUPPL sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = PrintLine)) ~> FFDESTSUPPFILE
